resources.string: Softlok uses this service to detect which app is in the foreground so it can enforce the time limits you set. It reads package names only, never screen content, text, or keystrokes.
Enter your override code, then choose extra time.
Too many attempts. Try again in %1$s.
The code was reset. Open Softlok to set a new one.
No override code is set. Open Softlok to set one.
Recovery is ready. Open Softlok to set a new override code.
No override code is set. Open Softlok to create one.
Recovery is active. A new code can be set in %1$s. Protection stays on.
Forgot the code? Protection stays on for 48 hours before a reset.
